meaning: READY_TO_IMPLEMENT means requirements for the named scope are settled, not code complete or tests passed. Dependencies are implementation work, not necessarily product decisions.

modules.scope: Restricted command infrastructure and versioned contract boundary
modules.retain: Existing HTTP service, dependency-injection seams, Auth/Storage integrations and migration history.
modules.adapt: Add v2.3 contract namespace and pinned transaction runner within this API; exact original request identities, root checks and domain receipts.
modules.replace: Administrative RPC ownership for new domain writes; payload-only legacy hashing is not the new immutable request identity.
modules.migration: No edits to applied migrations. New rounds schema isolated first, then explicit source-ID/count mapping and one-writer cutover; do not apply the clean schema to public legacy data.
modules.offline: Keep legacy endpoints serving original queues. Never mint current assignment authority for old observations; new clients gated until BS-05 compatibility passes.
modules.acceptance: AC-01/02/03/05/07; exact 131 metadata mirrors; same-ID races, rollback, tenant connection reuse and stale original-fence rejection under real restricted roles.
blocked: Shared database cutover and deployment require explicit environment approval; not a reason to delay local implementation.

modules.scope: Existing-workspace membership, city/site and typed policy configuration
modules.retain: Session restoration and explicit tenant selection mechanics.
modules.adapt: Replace broad role checks with live capabilities/city scope; add versioned typed policy editors in Phase39 settings surfaces.
modules.replace: Hard-coded fixture policy/tenant defaults and assumptions that a role name alone authorises all objects.
modules.migration: Map auth UID to global principal then tenant memberships/city grants; preserve existing identities and tenant IDs; no duplicate accounts.
modules.offline: Revocation blocks new commands, but preserves owned evidence for recovery; city switch must not retarget drafts.
modules.acceptance: P01/P13 cases and AC-07: two tenants/two cities, revoked roles, invalid policy discriminants, dirty editor and stale versions.
blocked: DEC-01 CreateTenant admission only; endpoint disabled pending response.
DEC-02/04 live proof/retention/fee configuration must be explicitly approved, never filled from examples.

modules.scope: Manual draft, address review, slot admission and whole-order commit
modules.retain: Manual form validation patterns and explicit draft UI, not the old field grouping where Phase39 differs.
modules.adapt: Draft/review/commit handlers, city timezone rather than todayInBangkok, original address provenance, slot reservation lifecycle and batch per-row outcomes.
modules.replace: Single create-delivery RPC as the entire intake lifecycle; no direct UI construction of final manifest/assignment authority.
modules.migration: Legacy deliveries become committed records with original source IDs and exactly one whole manifest unit; do not invent missing draft provenance or slots.
modules.offline: Dispatcher draft stays local on failure; CommitDelivery is online and reconciles original ID before retry, never duplicate intake.
modules.acceptance: P02/P03, AC-02/09: atomic last-slot/move/replay, timezone/overnight, delayed source correction and no split units.
blocked: Optional extraction/AI adapter until provider chosen. Manual intake is independent and remains ready.

modules.scope: Plan expected complete orders before arrival, stage, then explicitly release ready work
modules.retain: Road estimate adapter, capacity dimension presentation, explicit move-preview/acknowledgement concepts.
modules.adapt: Multi-dimensional capacity, full scheduled dwell/return time, immutable proposals and original plan input hashes, selected ready Rounds, provisional assignment acknowledgement.
modules.replace: Combined plan/approve RPC and current projection model where it conflates planning with departure. Zero/unready receipt must not block safe route planning.
modules.migration: Preserve plan/round/stop and selected-order identity; map unprovable legacy staged/released state to review rather than fabricate release facts.
modules.offline: Offline phone caches staged versus released separately; plan edits never refresh the original physical execution fence.
modules.acceptance: P04, AC-03/10: plan before receipt, pause workers and derive gates synchronously, missing D1 does not block adjusted complete D2, no silent consent change.
blocked: New E04 recovery variants require UI proposal review; existing source states can be ported immediately.

modules.scope: Whole-order pickup, handoff, proof, completion and essential return/issue recovery
modules.retain: Actual photo capture/upload/verification knowledge and existing pickup/handoff/issue form components after source comparison.
modules.adapt: New complete-order guard, original request/fence, stable unit-to-attempt result binding, real receiver/handoff and proof policy checks.
modules.replace: Manufactured server command IDs/versions and combined completeStopPod transaction; split RecordHandoff/SubmitProof/CompleteDelivery with atomic custody/proof transitions.
modules.migration: Preserve manifests, photos/checksums and real custody events. Never map demo completion to proof or split abnormal legacy stock; quarantine ambiguity for supervised recovery.
modules.offline: Physical observation remains local/durable until its original identity chain resolves; no invented fence or false delivered state.
modules.acceptance: AC-01/03/04/05/06 plus revised QA-V21-FULL-PICKUP/PARTIAL-APPROVAL. Exact decimal quantities, all batch negatives, no new residual unit, original-fence replay and pending proof visibility.
blocked: Live use without an approved tenant proof matrix; missing waiting/retained/return variants need the small UI proposals accepted before visual signoff.

modules.scope: Observation/binding/materialization architecture and non-destructive queue upgrade
modules.retain: Versioned local DB upgrade entry point, upload offset/checksum/file retention mechanics and pending evidence tests.
modules.adapt: Per-principal encrypted storage, persisted predecessor bindings, frozen request materialization, sender/status reconciler and file/DB crash recovery.
modules.replace: Final-endpoint-first queue coordination and current-server-session version substitution. DB version 5 is actual legacy code, not the 14-table v2.3 reference version.
dependencies: Native encrypted SQLite adapter spike and tests
modules.migration: Add a new storage format without dropping rounds_phase_zero.db or files; preserve ownership/hash/occurred time, drain provable old requests or quarantine missing fences, record conversion receipt.
modules.offline: Account switch cannot read/send another principal's observations; unknown response blocks descendants; recovery preserves original assignment even after reassignment.
modules.acceptance: AC-05 and E05: kill/restart each boundary, shuffled predecessor results, lost response, revoked device, encrypted bytes and upgrade with pending/uploading evidence.
blocked: Shipping the storage upgrade until real-device encryption and migration evidence exists; this is an engineering verification dependency, not a business decision.

modules.scope: Own-team identity/invites, shifts, vehicle and profile; Network-specific entry deferred to R3
modules.retain: Auth refresh, invite entry, actual OS permission queries, team home and profile interaction primitives.
modules.adapt: Global principal + employment relation, dated shifts/vehicle binding, scoped capability checks, queued attendance changes and source-aligned A/B/L screens.
modules.replace: Team identity conflated with a single tenant/current Round; no production debug sign-in or forced fake stop for employer chat.
modules.migration: Retain auth UUID/package ID/signing and chosen locale; create explicit membership/driver crosswalk, preserve shift history without inventing attendance.
modules.offline: Sign-out preserves locked pending data; shift end cannot erase custody; reconnect resolves original command before repeat clock-in/out.
modules.acceptance: P06/AC-07/10: used/revoked invite, overlapping vehicle race, physical obligations at shift end, original locale/queue preserved and false OS permission state rejected.
blocked: R3 KYC/liveness/payout provider decisions; not required for own-team workflow.

modules.scope: Text/media/voice-note conversations and durable notification workers
modules.retain: Per-thread drafts/IndexedDB, TUS hash/upload handling, actual chat and media picker/recorder integrations.
modules.adapt: Job/relationship conversation scope, immutable send identity, participant revocation, configured limits (old 8x15MB differs from v2.3 cap 10x20MB), safe retry and private hints.
modules.replace: Stop/name identity assumptions; mutable retries; demo received/call states. No complete durable worker service found in existing runtime tree: add it to this monorepo.
modules.migration: Keep messages and attachment ownership/keys/checksums; crosswalk old thread to explicit participants, never merge by driver display name. Old drafts remain separately recoverable.
modules.offline: Freeze sender/thread/attachment identity through retry; late recorder permission cannot attach to another conversation; preserve pending media during account change.
modules.acceptance: P09/E07/AC-08 plus revised notification retry case: same event after template change gives one effect; unknown provider outcome never resends blindly.
blocked: Integrated VoIP/incoming-call variant and real notification channel launch until DEC-03; ordinary media and voice notes remain ready.

modules.scope: Existing Mapbox/Google boundaries, exact controls, safe telemetry and unavailable weather states
modules.retain: Real Mapbox drawing/routing, geographic markers, Google navigation intent and native recorder integrations.
modules.adapt: Provider/profile/display provenance, Phase39 controls, job/tenant entitlement, bounded batches and stable current-position watermark. Ingest currently chooses the final array sample: explicitly test old/out-of-order batch cannot rewind position.
modules.replace: Fake weather/route states and any assumption that driving traffic legally represents Thai motorcycle/truck navigation.
dependencies: Existing configured keys with reviewed restrictions
modules.migration: Preserve navigation intent/stop/version and allowed location history; map old grants explicitly, don't start new off-duty collection or bulk-copy GPS without purpose policy.
modules.offline: Old allowed samples can fill history but not replace newer current position; navigation remount preserves intent and original destination authority.
modules.acceptance: P10/E06/AC-11: actual pan/rotate/satellite/2D/3D state, provider failure, old-location batch, revocation and combined device lifecycle matrix.
blocked: Real rain/Street View/unsupported vehicle adapter without DEC-03 and account rights; truthful unavailable UI is ready.

modules.scope: Whole-order history, safe exports, adapter contracts and tracking privacy
modules.retain: History presentation/filter patterns, CSV quoting/BOM and current evidence-view mechanics.
modules.adapt: New event-derived outcomes/metrics and paginated cutoff. Escape formula-looking CSV cells (current quoting alone is insufficient). Add private asynchronous exports and signature-verified source ingress.
modules.replace: Legacy delivered projection treated as complete proof, synchronous arbitrary export and any fixture/source callback pretending a verified external connection.
modules.migration: Preserve original event/asset IDs and distinguish unknown legacy proof from verified. Do not reconstruct receipts from labels or send historical completions to external systems.
modules.offline: History may display labeled last-synced data; download/send needs fresh permissions. Offline handoff remains evidence pending, not delivered.
modules.acceptance: P11/P12, AC-08/09/12: consistent counts/cutoff, signed webhook replay, CSV injection, surprise-recipient scope and revoked export/media access.
blocked: Live commerce/writeback/customer channels until selected signing/privacy/provider contracts; history/manual intake is independent.

modules.scope: R3 freelance acceptance, agreement changes and direct settlement; retained in full-product plan
modules.retain: Shared feasibility and explicit-change primitives only; no dedicated v2.3 offer/settlement implementation found in the inspected runtime modules.
modules.adapt: Global commitments, exclusive whole-order claims, consented amendments, exactly one accepted driver and immutable money evidence.
modules.replace: Do not repurpose team acknowledgement as freelance acceptance or existing demo fields as an agreement/financial ledger.
modules.migration: No synthetic historical agreements or payments. Preserve any real external evidence for reviewed import; new records need original counterpart/reference/currency.
modules.offline: Offer acceptance is online/reconciled, not assumed accepted; physical work uses the original accepted agreement/assignment fence.
modules.acceptance: P07/P15 and AC-13/14: one winner, immediate executable work, full-order readiness, prepay/refund/dispute and zero fabricated bank action.
blocked: Commercial terms and identity provider are genuine launch choices; domain mechanics are specified but R3 is not the current workflow.

modules.scope: R4 optional Intercity transport/receiver execution; pre-arrival planning is already required in BS-03
modules.retain: Routing and incremental custody receipt patterns as candidates; no dedicated v2.3 trip/receiver handler found in the inspected API.
modules.adapt: Explicit trip/booking/load/receipt and destination-hub roles, whole-order local dependency with independent completed orders.
modules.replace: Never model inbound arrival by a timer, simulated receipt or creating duplicate local deliveries.
modules.migration: No invented old trip lineage; preserve any real receipt balance and original manifest mapping. Optional-module disable retains active custody/history.
modules.offline: Transport/receiver observations preserve authenticated site/custodian identity; increment receipts exactly once; planners cannot fabricate them.
modules.acceptance: P08/J06/AC-15: plan before arrival, receive 2 then 3 of 5, replay zero, independent ready route, preserved stop IDs and full-order pickup.
blocked: Receiver/transport screens beyond the 47 HTML files require proposed components and approval before implementation of those new views.

modules.scope: Port existing English references and bind their real actions; proposed missing states await review
modules.retain: Shared drawer/form/map primitives where source geometry agrees; preserve all approved source HTML/assets exactly.
modules.adapt: Re-measure effective Refresh26/Phase39 CSS, typography and insets; bind all states/actions to typed commands. Old goldens do not become new references.
modules.replace: Old v45 layout/font/token assumptions and demo success handlers. Do not introduce new themes, default dropdowns or another full board.
modules.migration: UI-only changes preserve package/signing, route IDs, locale and pending drafts; migrate local draft fields explicitly if renamed.
modules.offline: Drawers remain dismissible; saved/pending/retained/uploaded/verified are different states; no layout reset erases evidence.
modules.acceptance: Every source/state hash, equal viewport/fixture, screenshot diff and action/error/keyboard/back behavior. NOT_RENDERED remains honest until actual authorized comparison.
blocked: Missing state artwork proposals pending review; original A02/E04 combined groups remain reference, not permission for redesign.
New Thai implementation deferred until English tested as instructed.

modules.scope: Isolation, evidence safety, migration verification and release gates
modules.retain: Existing permission-negative fixtures, private media handling knowledge and append-only migration history as evidence, not blanket certification.
modules.adapt: Restricted transaction roles, same-tenant keys, per-purpose assets, real grant revocation, encryption, bounded uploads and safe retention workflows.
modules.replace: Admin-role domain mutation and unsigned/expired/fixture authority; public client token presence is not approval of account restrictions.
modules.migration: Backup DB and object storage, compare ID/balance/checksum crosswalk, test restore and one writer per cohort. No queue/media/database reset.
modules.offline: Keep original encrypted evidence on revocation/account switch; recovery is authorized and auditable, not silent deletion or cross-account upload.
modules.acceptance: Two tenants/cities, wrong principal/asset purpose, revoked grant, malicious CSV/file, original-fence reassignment, restore-no-resend and pending-evidence upgrade.
blocked: DEC-04 retention/legal purpose and release targets before production; security implementation itself is ready now.
